note: Start-up hook files committed to the tree on purpose (checker.pinned_tree_hooks; DECISION_LOG D-83 addendum). A path here is never at a start-up root of a measured process (src/, tests/, the crucible root, the repository top) and runs only where committed code puts its directory on PYTHONPATH. Any change of a pinned file un-pins it until this baseline is updated with the new sha256 after review of the diff.

src/crucible/scale/_slotsite/sitecustomi.why: GPU memory cap and GPU usage reporter of governed slot jobs: the slot supervisor prepends this directory to PYTHONPATH of jobs granted GPU memory; the official runner's measured processes never have it (their PYTHONPATH is the clone's src only)
